clips.title: The story
paras: Barnil Stonepot is trying to reconstruct the third chapter of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting manuscript in Stranglethorn Vale. The section recounts the first kill made with a dwarven rifle by Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack, but four specific leaves were blown across the jungle.

Barnil Stonepot considers this portion of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn his personal favorite. The text recounts the early exploits of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack, detailing their very first kill using a dwarven rifle. The chapter ends on a sharp cliffhanger.

To piece the narrative together again, Barnil requires pages 18, 20, 21, and 24. These missing fragments were scattered into the wild, carried off across Stranglethorn Vale like the rest of the manuscript.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chapter III was my favorite. It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle. And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!
Looks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter. Those pages are out there somewhere...

clips.title: Progress

paras: Phew! Good work, friend. Chapter III is now back together in one piece!
